reason: Seeing the cash drawer and who is in the chair while I'm at my other work is exactly what I worry about, but for a one- or two-chair shop ₹5,000 upfront plus ₹1,000 every month is too much out of what I earn. My notebook is free and I already know most of my regulars.
objection: If the phone breaks or the company shuts down, where does all my customer data go? And I'd be paying ₹12,000 a year whether the month was good or slow.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee, around ₹399-499 a month, and a clear promise that my data is backed up and I can download it even if I stop paying.
